thm proposition_1:
    ? forall a, b cart(R, R):
        a != b
        =>:
            exist z cart(R, R) st {$m0::f0::is_equilateral(a, b, z)}
    have c cart(R, R) = f4::equilateral_vertex(a, b)
    have x R = (b(1) - a(1))
    have y R = (b(2) - a(2))
    f4::equilateral_vertex(a, b) = ((((a(1) + b(1)) / 2) - ((sqrt (3) * (b(2) - a(2))) / 2)), (((a(2) + b(2)) / 2) + ((sqrt (3) * (b(1) - a(1))) / 2)))
    c = ((((a(1) + b(1)) / 2) - ((sqrt (3) * (b(2) - a(2))) / 2)), (((a(2) + b(2)) / 2) + ((sqrt (3) * (b(1) - a(1))) / 2)))
    c(1) = (((a(1) + b(1)) / 2) - ((sqrt (3) * y) / 2))
    c(2) = (((a(2) + b(2)) / 2) + ((sqrt (3) * x) / 2))
    release thm m0::f0::vec_coordinate_formula(a, b)
    m0::f0::vec(a, b)(1) = x
    m0::f0::vec(a, b)(2) = y
    release thm m0::f0::distance_sq_coordinate_formula(a, b)
    m0::f0::distance_sq(a, b) = (((b(1) - a(1)) ^ 2) + ((b(2) - a(2)) ^ 2)) = ((x ^ 2) + (y ^ 2))
    release thm m0::f0::distance_sq_positive_of_ne(a, b)
    ((x ^ 2) + (y ^ 2)) > 0
    (sqrt (3) ^ 2) = 3
    sqrt (3) > 0
    (c(1) - a(1)) = ((((a(1) + b(1)) / 2) - ((sqrt (3) * y) / 2)) - a(1)) = (((b(1) - a(1)) / 2) - ((sqrt (3) * y) / 2)) = ((x / 2) - ((sqrt (3) * y) / 2))
    (c(2) - a(2)) = ((((a(2) + b(2)) / 2) + ((sqrt (3) * x) / 2)) - a(2)) = (((b(2) - a(2)) / 2) + ((sqrt (3) * x) / 2)) = ((y / 2) + ((sqrt (3) * x) / 2))
    (c(1) - b(1)) = ((((a(1) + b(1)) / 2) - ((sqrt (3) * y) / 2)) - b(1)) = (((-(b(1) - a(1))) / 2) - ((sqrt (3) * y) / 2)) = (((-x) / 2) - ((sqrt (3) * y) / 2))
    (c(2) - b(2)) = ((((a(2) + b(2)) / 2) + ((sqrt (3) * x) / 2)) - b(2)) = (((-(b(2) - a(2))) / 2) + ((sqrt (3) * x) / 2)) = (((-y) / 2) + ((sqrt (3) * x) / 2))
    m0::f0::vec(a, c)(1) = ((x / 2) - ((sqrt (3) * y) / 2))
    m0::f0::vec(a, c)(2) = ((y / 2) + ((sqrt (3) * x) / 2))
    m0::f0::vec(b, c)(1) = (((-x) / 2) - ((sqrt (3) * y) / 2))
    m0::f0::vec(b, c)(2) = (((-y) / 2) + ((sqrt (3) * x) / 2))
    ((((x / 2) - ((sqrt (3) * y) / 2)) ^ 2) + (((y / 2) + ((sqrt (3) * x) / 2)) ^ 2)) = (((1 + (sqrt (3) ^ 2)) * ((x ^ 2) + (y ^ 2))) / 4) = ((x ^ 2) + (y ^ 2))
    (((((-x) / 2) - ((sqrt (3) * y) / 2)) ^ 2) + ((((-y) / 2) + ((sqrt (3) * x) / 2)) ^ 2)) = (((1 + (sqrt (3) ^ 2)) * ((x ^ 2) + (y ^ 2))) / 4) = ((x ^ 2) + (y ^ 2))
    release thm m0::f0::distance_sq_coordinate_formula(a, c)
    m0::f0::distance_sq(a, c) = (((c(1) - a(1)) ^ 2) + ((c(2) - a(2)) ^ 2)) = ((((x / 2) - ((sqrt (3) * y) / 2)) ^ 2) + (((y / 2) + ((sqrt (3) * x) / 2)) ^ 2)) = ((x ^ 2) + (y ^ 2))
    release thm m0::f0::distance_sq_coordinate_formula(b, c)
    m0::f0::distance_sq(b, c) = (((c(1) - b(1)) ^ 2) + ((c(2) - b(2)) ^ 2)) = (((((-x) / 2) - ((sqrt (3) * y) / 2)) ^ 2) + ((((-y) / 2) + ((sqrt (3) * x) / 2)) ^ 2)) = ((x ^ 2) + (y ^ 2))
    release thm m0::f0::distance_sq_symmetric(c, a)
    m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(a, b), m0::f0::vec(a, c)) = ((x * ((y / 2) + ((sqrt (3) * x) / 2))) - (y * ((x / 2) - ((sqrt (3) * y) / 2)))) = ((sqrt (3) * ((x ^ 2) + (y ^ 2))) / 2)
    have norm_sq R+ = ((x ^ 2) + (y ^ 2))
    sqrt (3) $in R+
    (sqrt (3) * norm_sq) $in R+
    ((sqrt (3) * norm_sq) / 2) $in R+
    ((sqrt (3) * ((x ^ 2) + (y ^ 2))) / 2) = ((sqrt (3) * norm_sq) / 2) > 0
    m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(a, b), m0::f0::vec(a, c)) != 0
    by def $m0::f0::is_triangle(a, b, c)
    by def $m0::f0::are_segments_congruent(a, b, b, c)
    by def $m0::f0::are_segments_congruent(b, c, c, a)
    by def $m0::f0::is_equilateral(a, b, c)
    release obj def m0::f0::circle
    have radius R+ = sqrt (m0::f0::distance_sq(a, b))
    (sqrt (m0::f0::distance_sq(a, b)) ^ 2) = m0::f0::distance_sq(a, b)
    (radius ^ 2) = (sqrt (m0::f0::distance_sq(a, b)) ^ 2) = m0::f0::distance_sq(a, b)
    m0::f0::distance_sq(a, c) = (radius * radius)
    m0::f0::distance_sq(b, c) = (radius * radius)
    c $in m0::f0::circle(a, radius)
    c $in m0::f0::circle(b, radius)
    witness exist z cart(R, R) st {$m0::f0::is_equilateral(a, b, z)} from c
stores:
forall a, b cart(R, R):
    a != b
    =>:
        exist z cart(R, R) st {$m0::f0::is_equilateral(a, b, z)}

prop have_equal_equimultiple_comparisons(a, b, c, d R+):
    forall m, n N+:
        =>:
            (m * a) < (n * b)
        <=>:
            (m * c) < (n * d)
    forall m, n N+:
        =>:
            (m * a) = (n * b)
        <=>:
            (m * c) = (n * d)
    forall m, n N+:
        =>:
            (m * a) > (n * b)
        <=>:
            (m * c) > (n * d)

thm cross_product_preserves_less_equimultiples:
    ? forall a, b, c, d R+, m, n N+:
        (a * d) = (b * c)
        (m * a) < (n * b)
        =>:
            (m * c) < (n * d)
    have scale R+ = (c / a)
    scale > 0
    c = ((c / a) * a) = (scale * a)
    d = ((a * d) / a) = ((b * c) / a) = ((c / a) * b) = (scale * b)
    m $in R+
    n $in R+
    (m * c) = (m * (scale * a)) = (scale * (m * a))
    (n * d) = (n * (scale * b)) = (scale * (n * b))
    (scale * (m * a)) < (scale * (n * b))
    (m * c) < (n * d)
stores:
forall a, b, c, d R+, m, n N+:
    (a * d) = (b * c)
    (m * a) < (n * b)
    =>:
        (m * c) < (n * d)

thm cross_product_implies_equal_equimultiple_comparisons:
    ? forall a, b, c, d R+:
        (a * d) = (b * c)
        =>:
            $f4::have_equal_equimultiple_comparisons(a, b, c, d)
    (c * b) = (b * c) = (a * d) = (d * a)
    claim:
        ? forall m, n N+:
            (m * a) < (n * b)
            =>:
                (m * c) < (n * d)
        release thm cross_product_preserves_less_equimultiples(a, b, c, d, m, n)
    claim:
        ? forall m, n N+:
            (m * c) < (n * d)
            =>:
                (m * a) < (n * b)
        release thm cross_product_preserves_less_equimultiples(c, d, a, b, m, n)
    claim:
        ? forall m, n N+:
            (m * a) = (n * b)
            =>:
                (m * c) = (n * d)
        release thm cross_product_preserves_equal_equimultiples(a, b, c, d, m, n)
    claim:
        ? forall m, n N+:
            (m * c) = (n * d)
            =>:
                (m * a) = (n * b)
        release thm cross_product_preserves_equal_equimultiples(c, d, a, b, m, n)
    claim:
        ? forall m, n N+:
            (m * a) > (n * b)
            =>:
                (m * c) > (n * d)
        release thm cross_product_preserves_greater_equimultiples(a, b, c, d, m, n)
    claim:
        ? forall m, n N+:
            (m * c) > (n * d)
            =>:
                (m * a) > (n * b)
        release thm cross_product_preserves_greater_equimultiples(c, d, a, b, m, n)
    by def $f4::have_equal_equimultiple_comparisons(a, b, c, d)
stores:
forall a, b, c, d R+:
    (a * d) = (b * c)
    =>:
        $f4::have_equal_equimultiple_comparisons(a, b, c, d)

thm positive_rational_separation:
    ? forall x, y R+:
        x < y
        =>:
            exist numerator, denominator N+ st {x < (numerator / denominator), (numerator / denominator) < y}
    release thm rational_between_reals(x, y)
    obtain middle from exist q Q st {x < q and q < y}
    release thm rational_has_unique_reduced_fraction(middle)
    obtain numerator, denominator from exist! p Z, d N+ st {middle = (p / d), gcd(p, d) = 1}
    middle > x > 0
    denominator $in R+
    (middle * denominator) > 0
    numerator = ((numerator / denominator) * denominator) = (middle * denominator) > 0
    numerator $in N+
    x < middle = (numerator / denominator) < y
    witness exist n, m N+ st {x < (n / m), (n / m) < y} from numerator, denominator
stores:
forall x, y R+:
    x < y
    =>:
        exist numerator, denominator N+ st {x < (numerator / denominator), (numerator / denominator) < y}

statement_results.statement:
thm strict_cross_product_has_separating_equimultiples:
    ? forall a, b, c, d R+:
        (a * d) < (b * c)
        =>:
            exist m, n N+ st {(m * a) < (n * b), (m * c) > (n * d)}
    (b * d) > 0
    ((a * d) / (b * d)) < ((b * c) / (b * d))
    (a / b) = ((a * d) / (b * d)) < ((b * c) / (b * d)) = (c / d)
    (a / b) > 0
    (c / d) > 0
    release thm positive_rational_separation((a / b), (c / d))
    obtain n, m from exist numerator, denominator N+ st {(a / b) < (numerator / denominator), (numerator / denominator) < (c / d)}
    m $in R+
    n $in R+
    (m * (a / b)) < (m * (n / m))
    ((m * (a / b)) * b) < ((m * (n / m)) * b)
    (m * a) = ((m * (a / b)) * b) < ((m * (n / m)) * b) = (n * b)
    (m * (n / m)) < (m * (c / d))
    ((m * (n / m)) * d) < ((m * (c / d)) * d)
    (n * d) = ((m * (n / m)) * d) < ((m * (c / d)) * d) = (m * c)
    witness exist first, second N+ st {(first * a) < (second * b), (first * c) > (second * d)} from m, n
stores:
forall a, b, c, d R+:
    (a * d) < (b * c)
    =>:
        exist m, n N+ st {(m * a) < (n * b), (m * c) > (n * d)}

thm equal_equimultiple_comparisons_imply_cross_product:
    ? forall a, b, c, d R+:
        $f4::have_equal_equimultiple_comparisons(a, b, c, d)
        =>:
            (a * d) = (b * c)
    by def $f4::have_equal_equimultiple_comparisons(a, b, c, d)
    by contra:
        ? (a * d) >= (b * c)
        (a * d) < (b * c)
        release thm strict_cross_product_has_separating_equimultiples(a, b, c, d)
        obtain m, n from exist m, n N+ st {(m * a) < (n * b), (m * c) > (n * d)}
        (m * c) < (n * d)
        impossible (m * c) > (n * d)
    by contra:
        ? (a * d) <= (b * c)
        (a * d) > (b * c)
        (c * b) = (b * c) < (a * d) = (d * a)
        release thm strict_cross_product_has_separating_equimultiples(c, d, a, b)
        obtain m, n from exist m, n N+ st {(m * c) < (n * d), (m * a) > (n * b)}
        (m * a) < (n * b)
        impossible (m * a) > (n * b)
    (a * d) = (b * c)
stores:
forall a, b, c, d R+:
    $f4::have_equal_equimultiple_comparisons(a, b, c, d)
    =>:
        (a * d) = (b * c)

thm equal_equimultiple_comparisons_give_equal_quotients:
    ? forall a, b, c, d R+:
        $f4::have_equal_equimultiple_comparisons(a, b, c, d)
        =>:
            (a / b) = (c / d)
    release thm equal_equimultiple_comparisons_imply_cross_product(a, b, c, d)
    (b * d) > 0
    (a / b) = ((a * d) / (b * d)) = ((b * c) / (b * d)) = (c / d)
stores:
forall a, b, c, d R+:
    $f4::have_equal_equimultiple_comparisons(a, b, c, d)
    =>:
        (a / b) = (c / d)

thm proportional_squared_sides_give_equal_angle:
    ? forall p, q, r, u, v, w cart(R, R), scale R+:
        p != q
        r != q
        u != v
        w != v
        m0::f0::distance_sq(v, u) = ((scale ^ 2) * m0::f0::distance_sq(q, p))
        m0::f0::distance_sq(v, w) = ((scale ^ 2) * m0::f0::distance_sq(q, r))
        m0::f0::distance_sq(u, w) = ((scale ^ 2) * m0::f0::distance_sq(p, r))
        =>:
            $m0::f0::are_angles_congruent(p, q, r, u, v, w)
    release thm m0::f0::dot_from_cosine_law(p, q, r)
    release thm m0::f0::dot_from_cosine_law(u, v, w)
    release thm m0::f0::distance_sq_symmetric(p, q)
    release thm m0::f0::distance_sq_symmetric(u, v)
    have x R = m0::f0::distance_sq(q, p)
    have y R = m0::f0::distance_sq(q, r)
    have z R = m0::f0::distance_sq(p, r)
    m0::f0::distance_sq(p, q) = m0::f0::distance_sq(q, p) = x
    m0::f0::distance_sq(u, v) = m0::f0::distance_sq(v, u) = ((scale ^ 2) * m0::f0::distance_sq(q, p)) = ((scale ^ 2) * x)
    m0::f0::distance_sq(v, w) = ((scale ^ 2) * m0::f0::distance_sq(q, r)) = ((scale ^ 2) * y)
    m0::f0::distance_sq(u, w) = ((scale ^ 2) * m0::f0::distance_sq(p, r)) = ((scale ^ 2) * z)
    m0::f0::distance_sq(u, v) = ((scale ^ 2) * x)
    m0::f0::distance_sq(v, w) = ((scale ^ 2) * y)
    m0::f0::distance_sq(u, w) = ((scale ^ 2) * z)
